description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

- New: editing a comment that has an image or GIF keeps it. The image shows as its link on its own line: leave it to keep the image, delete it to remove the image, or delete it and pick a new one to replace it.
- New: the image button now also works when editing a comment, so you can add an image to a text-only comment.
